title: Computation of Sixth-Order Strong Coupling Expansion Coefficient for the Fermi-Hubbard Model on Honeycomb Lattice

contributions.mechanism: Julia上有限周期簇精确对角化(ED,restarted Lanczos)+约束多项式拟合,含几何/U=0/Heisenberg三重校验
contributions.evaluation: U=0能量匹配单粒子带能到1e-10/site;Heisenberg映射c2=-3.810287162761664与无约束拟合差<5e-8
contributions.source_quote: Our method combines exact diagonalization on finite periodic clusters with constrained polynomial analysis, yielding a stable and accurate estimate.

contributions.mechanism: 对U/4平移后能量做加权约束拟合(固定c2,含1/U^7项估truncation)

notes: 有真实Julia代码附录(HoneyED),方法较具体。但数据红旗突出:(1)摘要自曝'[The results were generated by AI and have not been fully verified by humans]'(AI自我披露未经人类核验);(2)大量破损/幻影引用:正文出现'[24?]''[40?]''[1? ? ? ?, 2]''[5,14,15,18? ?]'等占位问号,参考文献未对齐(幻影引用);(3)精度自相矛盾:反复宣称'six significant digits精度',但结果不确定度±3.8(约3位有效数字);(4)'收敛'存疑:四个Umin拟合值单调下移(-940.9→-948.6,每步约±1)并未收敛,却称'converge systematically'并挑Umin=100;(5)Related Work引先前'c6≈-940.251 on N=12'疑为杜撰。checklist未在提取文本中出现(PDF尾部代码占用)。无self-declared extend/adapt明确原句。
